definition: An individual California public school recorded in the schools table, identified by a 14-character CDS code whose final 7-digit school segment is not '0000000'.
name: School
scope: School-level analysis across the schools, frpm and satscores tables.

definition: An administrative district that operates one or more schools; labelled by schools.District, frpm.'District Name' and satscores.dname, and identified by the district segment (digits 3-7) of the CDS code.
name: School District
scope: District-level analysis and district-name lookups such as 'Fresno Unified'.

definition: California county in which a school is located, stored as the full county name and also encoded as the first two digits of the CDS code.
name: County
scope: Geographic grouping and partition of schools.

definition: The 14-character California Department of Education County-District-School code. Characters 1-2 hold the county code, 3-7 the district code and 8-14 the school code; a school segment of '0000000' denotes a district-level record rather than a school.
name: CDS Code
scope: Primary identifier linking the schools, frpm and satscores tables.

definition: Whether a school is a charter school; coded 1 for charter schools and 0 for non-charter schools.
name: Charter School Status
scope: Filtering schools by charter or non-charter status.

definition: The extent to which a school delivers instruction virtually. Observed codes in schools.Virtual are 'F', 'N' and 'P', plus blank for district-level rows; 'F' denotes a school that is exclusively virtual and therefore does not offer a physical building.
name: Virtual Instruction Status
scope: Identifying virtual schools and schools without a physical building.

definition: Numeric code classifying the administrative type of a district, e.g. 54 = Unified School District, 52 = Elementary School District, 56 = High School District, 00 = County Office of Education; stored as text in schools.DOC with the matching descriptive label in frpm.'District Type'.
name: District Ownership Code (DOC)
scope: Distinguishing district types, including Unified versus Elementary school districts.

definition: Numeric code classifying the ownership and level of a school, e.g. 66 = High Schools (Public), 60 = Elementary Schools (Public), 62 = Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public); stored as text in schools.SOC with the matching label in schools.SOCType and frpm.'School Type'.
name: School Ownership Code (SOC)
scope: Selecting schools by ownership or level code, for example 'ownership code 66'.

definition: Operational status of a school record: Active, Closed, Merged or Pending. Closed and merged schools remain present in the table and may carry a ClosedDate.
name: School Status Type
scope: Restricting analysis to currently operating schools.

definition: Date on which the school opened, stored as an ISO date string in schools.OpenDate.
name: School Open Date
scope: Founding and age analysis of schools, for example 'opened after 1991'.

definition: Date on which the school closed, stored as an ISO date string in schools.ClosedDate and null for schools that have not closed.
name: School Closed Date
scope: Closure analysis, for example 'closed before 2000'.

definition: The range of grades a school offers (schools.GSoffered) and the range it actually serves (schools.GSserved), stored as strings such as 'K-5', '9-12' or 'K-12'.
name: Grade Span Offered and Served
scope: Selecting schools by the grades they cover.

definition: The grade range running from kindergarten or first grade through twelfth grade. In the frpm table it is expressed by the '(K-12)' suffix on the enrollment and meal-count measures and by the Low Grade / High Grade columns delimiting each row's grade span.
name: K-12 Grade Range
scope: Interpreting the '(K-12)' measures and questions phrased as 'grades 1 through 12'.

definition: Number of students enrolled in kindergarten through grade 12 at the school, as reported for the free and reduced-price meal program data.
name: Enrollment (K-12)
scope: Denominator for meal-program rates and enrollment comparison questions.

definition: Number of students aged 5 to 17 enrolled at the school; an age-based alternative to the K-12 grade-based enrollment count.
name: Enrollment (Ages 5-17)
scope: Age-based enrollment analysis and comparison against K-12 enrollment.

definition: Number of K-12 students eligible for free meals under the National School Lunch Program.
name: Free Meal Count (K-12)
scope: Numerator of the eligible free meal rate.

aliases: free or reduced price meal count
definition: Number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals; the sum of the free-meal count and the reduced-price-meal count, and therefore never smaller than the free-meal count.
name: Free or Reduced Price Meal Count (K-12)
scope: Numerator of the eligible FRPM rate and ranking of schools by meal-program need.

definition: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free meals, computed as free meal count divided by K-12 enrollment and stored as a ratio in [0, 1] in the column named 'Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)'.
name: Eligible Free Meal Rate (K-12)
scope: Questions about the percent of eligible free meals for grades 1 through 12.

aliases: eligible free or reduced price meal rate
definition: Share of K-12 enrollment eligible for free or reduced-price meals, computed as FRPM count divided by K-12 enrollment and stored as a ratio in [0, 1] in the column named 'Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)'.
name: Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)
scope: Questions about the eligible free or reduced price meal rate.

definition: Average SAT reading score of the school's test takers, stored in satscores.AvgScrRead on the 200-800 SAT section scale.
name: SAT Average Reading Score
scope: Ranking or filtering schools by reading performance, for example 'lowest average score in reading'.

definition: Average SAT mathematics score of the school's test takers, stored in satscores.AvgScrMath on the 200-800 SAT section scale.
name: SAT Average Math Score
scope: Ranking or filtering schools by mathematics performance.

definition: Average SAT writing score of the school's test takers, stored in satscores.AvgScrWrite on the 200-800 SAT section scale.
name: SAT Average Writing Score
scope: Ranking or filtering schools by writing performance.

definition: Number of students at the school who took the SAT, stored in satscores.NumTstTakr.
name: SAT Test Takers
scope: Weighting or validating SAT averages and identifying schools without test takers.

definition: Distinguishes school-level SAT rows ('S') from district-level aggregate rows ('D') inside the satscores table; district rows carry no school name and a CDS code whose school segment is '0000000'.
name: SAT Record Type
scope: Selecting the intended level of SAT aggregation.

definition: Contact telephone number of the school, stored as formatted text in schools.Phone with an optional extension in schools.Ext.
name: School Phone Number
scope: Contact-detail questions such as 'telephone number' or 'communication number'.

definition: The street address of the school's physical location, stored in schools.Street with an abbreviated form in schools.StreetAbr.
name: School Street Address
scope: Address questions such as 'full street address' or 'postal street address'.

definition: The street address used for correspondence mailed to the school, stored in schools.MailStreet with an abbreviated form in schools.MailStrAbr; it may differ from the physical street address.
name: School Mailing Street Address
scope: Mailing-address questions; workload phrasing treats 'mailing street' and 'postal street' as synonyms.

definition: The funding arrangement recorded for a school, for example 'Directly funded' or 'Locally funded' in schools.FundingType; the frpm table records the equivalent per-charter value in 'Charter Funding Type'.
name: Charter School Funding Type
scope: Funding-type questions about schools or districts.
